app.tagline: A cloud business platform for branches, warehouses, and granular permissions in one place.
app.point_cloud: Cloud database is the single source of truth
app.point_branches: Multiple branches and warehouses with strict isolation
app.point_permissions: Fine-grained screen, action, and branch permissions
auth.subtitle: Enter your credentials to access the workspace.
auth.change_password_hint: Choose a strong password meeting the minimum length configured by the administrator.
auth.password_changed: Password changed. Please sign in again.
auth.session_expired: Your session expired due to inactivity. Please sign in again.
auth.no_branch: Sign-in denied: the user is not linked to any branch. Contact the administrator.
auth.invalid_refresh: Session expired. Please sign in again.
dashboard.shortcuts_hint: Only screens allowed for your account are shown.
branches.title: Branches
branches.hint: Manage company branches. Deleting a branch in use automatically deactivates it.
branches.delete_confirm: Branch '{0}' will be deleted or deactivated if in use. Continue?
branch.deactivated: Branch is in use and was deactivated instead of deleted
warehouses.title: Warehouses
warehouses.hint: Manage warehouses and link each one to one or more branches.
warehouses.delete_confirm: Warehouse '{0}' will be deleted or deactivated if in use. Continue?
warehouse.deactivated: Warehouse is in use and was deactivated instead of deleted
currencies.hint: Available currencies. Exactly one base currency is allowed.
custom_fields.title: Custom Fields
custom_fields.hint: Add fields from the UI without changing the database; they appear automatically in the entity form.
custom_fields.key_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores; must start with a letter.
custom_fields.label: Label
users.hint: Manage users, branch and warehouse assignments, roles, and individual overrides.
users.name: Name
users.reset_password_hint: All active sessions for this user will be revoked after reset.
users.password_helper: Leave blank to keep the current password.
users.branch_required_hint: A non-admin user must be linked to at least one branch to sign in.
users.warehouse_coverage_hint: Every warehouse linked to the user must belong to one of their branches.
users.delete_confirm: Delete user '{0}'? The user will be deactivated if they have history.
user.deactivated: User has data or history and was deactivated instead of deleted
roles.hint: Roles bundle permissions; per-user overrides take precedence.
roles.delete_confirm: Delete role '{0}'? It will be deactivated if assigned to users.
role.deactivated: Role is assigned to users and was deactivated
settings.general_hint: Core system settings and security policies.
audit.hint: Immutable activity log, newest first, using database-level keyset pagination.
audit.no_payload: No old or new payload was recorded for this activity.
database.hint: Super Admin console: connection status, tables, migrations, and row editing under a dedicated permission.
database.migration_note: Migrations run from numbered SQL scripts in the repository via DbUp. No data is dropped; only new scripts run. The same runner is used by CI/CD.
database.run_confirm: Only new scripts will run, each in its own transaction. Continue?
database.delete_warning: This deletion is permanent and cannot be undone. It will be recorded in the activity log.
database.edit_warning: Direct production data edit. Protected fields such as passwords and tokens cannot be changed here.
database.protected_columns_hint: Protected fields (id, password_hash, token_hash, version, search_text) are ignored.
qa.hint: Dynamic quality center: code-registered tests, selective execution, and traceable results.
qa.isolation_note: Tests never run against the application database. A separate QA database is required; if isolation cannot be verified, execution fails closed.
qa.runs_hint: Each run stores the selected tests, trace ID, and results.
qa.isolation_required: QA database must be different from the application database
error.title: An unexpected error occurred
error.generic: The operation could not be completed. The error was logged with a trace ID; technical details are not shown here.
error.forbidden_detail: This screen or action is not allowed for your account. Contact the administrator if you believe this is a mistake.
error.not_found_detail: The link is invalid or the page has moved.
error.antiforgery: The form expired. Please try again.
error.version_conflict: The record was modified by another user
error.reload_hint: Reload the data and try again.
error.branch_not_allowed: This branch is not allowed for the user
error.admin_flag_forbidden: Only a Super Admin can change administrator flags
validation.session_timeout: Session timeout must be between 5 and 480 minutes
validation.password_min_length: Minimum password length must be between 8 and 64
validation.max_attempts: Failed attempts must be between 1 and 20
validation.lockout_minutes: Lockout duration must be between 1 and 1440 minutes
validation.duplicate_code: This code is already in use
validation.duplicate_name: This name is already in use
validation.duplicate_field: This field key already exists for the entity
validation.super_admin_requires_admin: A Super Admin must also be an administrator
validation.user_branch_required: A non-admin user must be linked to at least one branch
validation.password_short: Password is shorter than the configured minimum
validation.password_same_as_username: Password cannot be the same as the username
validation.base_currency_required: At least one base currency must remain
validation.currency_code_invalid: Currency code must be exactly 3 letters
validation.warehouse_not_in_branches: Warehouse '{warehouses}' does not belong to any of the user's branches
validation.branch_in_use: Branch is referenced by other records; deactivate it instead
validation.warehouse_in_use: Warehouse is referenced by other records; deactivate it instead
validation.related_record: The record is referenced by other data
validation.last_super_admin: The last active Super Admin cannot be deleted or deactivated
validation.cannot_change_own_admin: You cannot change your own account type or deactivate it here
validation.cannot_delete_self: You cannot delete your current account
validation.cannot_deactivate_self: You cannot deactivate your current account
validation.entity_not_supported: This entity does not support custom fields
validation.field_options_required: A list field requires at least one option
